subject: 1029 W 1020 N rezoning meeting
comment: Follow Up Flag: Follow up Flag Status: Flagged Dear Dustin, We held a meeting about the rezone. Two neighbors joined in person and it appeared that 3 or 4 people joined on‐line. John, the interim council office director, also was present. Phillip Ng made a presentation about the process and their plans and then took questions. There were a number of questions of clarification as well as questions that went beyond the issue of rezoning related to the setback and design of the home. Because it was not necessary, we did not take a vote, but among those participating in person there was, unsolicited, unanimous support for the rezone. One neighbor called me yesterday and expressed concerns about parking and short‐term rentals. Before they were aware that short‐term rentals were not allowed, the Ngs briefly rented a room out in their home as a short‐term rental but once they learned of the rule back in January 2019, they stopped doing so. I have no concerns about their compliance in the new home. As neighborhood chair, I see no reason why this rezone should not be approved. I hope the Planning Commission and Council will agree. Please let me know if you have any questions. Sincerely, Aaron Skabelund Chair Rivergrove Neighborhood 1
